title: Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired chicken curry recipe made with a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add curry powder, cumin, and mustard to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add coconut milk and chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-15 minutes.
Stir in curry leaves and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
